## SafariClient.addReadingListItem() method

Add a new Reading List item with the given URL. Allows a custom title and preview text to be specified.

**Signature:**

```typescript
addReadingListItem(andPreviewText?: string, withTitle?: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<void>;
```
